dossier.scp_unleashed.035.title: Possessive Mask
dossier.scp_unleashed.035.caption: SCP-035 on its plinth, photographed through locker glass before the glass was removed.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-035 is to be kept in a storage locker with a solid door, shut at all times. The locker is never to be fitted with a glass front.
Staff are not to look at SCP-035 directly. Before the locker is opened, everyone in the room must be out of its line of sight.
**SCP-035 is never to be left where it can be seen. No one who has worn it has survived.**
If SCP-035 is found loose, clear the area and break line of sight. Do not approach it.
Any SCP-035-1 instance is to be held in a stasis pod or put down, and the mask contained at once.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-035 is a white porcelain mask in the style of a theatre tragedy mask, with a braided band across the brow. Its expression is one of open grief.
Anyone who can see SCP-035 is drawn to it. The subject's gaze locks onto the mask, and they drift toward it. Subjects who fight it can back away, slowly.
If a subject comes within reach, SCP-035 moves onto their face and cannot be removed. Any headgear in the way is pushed aside or broken.
Wearing SCP-035 is fatal. It strikes as it closes over the face, then drains the wearer faster with every second, and no treatment slows it. Wearers have died within ten seconds.
When a wearer dies, the body rises as SCP-035-1. It is hostile, wears the mask, and keeps the wearer's likeness. Killing it frees the mask.
SCP-035 cannot be damaged by any means tested. %rIt only wants a face it can see.%r

page.title: Addendum 035-1: Incident Log
text: Incident 035-03: a researcher moved SCP-035 into a glass-fronted locker for study. Within the hour she was found dead at the locker door, still wearing it.
Incident 035-06: a D-class subject sent to fetch SCP-035 from a corridor walked straight to it and put it on.
Incident 035-08: an agent dropped SCP-035 while carrying it out. It landed face-up. The agent did not leave the corridor.
Incident 035-11: an SCP-035-1 instance was put down in the lower wing. The mask was found on the floor beside it, face-up.

page.title: Addendum 035-2: Appearance
page.text: SCP-035 has no recovery record. It was first found lying on the ground near a reader of this file, a few minutes after the reading. It has come the same way each time since. %rDo not read this file alone.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp035.1: SCP-035 is a porcelain tragedy mask. Some time after its file is read, it turns up lying face-up on the ground near the reader.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp035.2: Anyone who can see it within %s blocks is drawn in. Their gaze is held on the mask and they drift toward it. Walking away is possible, only slower, until it is out of sight or out of range.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp035.3: If they reach it, the mask leaps onto their face and cannot be removed. A helmet already worn is moved into the inventory, or destroyed if there is no room.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp035.4: If the wearer dies, the mask leaves with them and an SCP-035-1 rises where they fell, wearing their likeness. It can be held in a stasis pod. Killing it leaves the mask on the ground.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp035.5: Carried, it puts itself on within about %s seconds. Dropped, it lands face-up again. Sneak and use it on a block to set it down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp035.6: Contain it in a storage locker. Behind a solid door that is shut it is inert. Open, or behind glass, it draws in anyone who can see it.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp035.0: It turns up near the reader, face-up.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp035.1: Do not hold its gaze. Wearing it kills.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp035.2: Shut it away. It wants a face.
item.scp_unleashed.scp035_mask.fatal: Fatal to wear: it kills within seconds.
death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp035_posses: %1$s gave SCP-035 a face while fighting %2$s
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp035.fatal: Wearing it is fatal. It strikes for %s hearts as it closes, then drains its wearer faster every second, and nothing heals them. From full health, death comes in about eight seconds. A totem buys one more try; the mask stays on.
